messages:
Maria (Customer Success): Quick heads-up 1: Zephyr dedicated pool go-live tomorrow. Need final sign-off on quota, autoscale policy, and a short load-test to include in renewal evidence.
Sam (Operations): Pool spec: 6x A100 48GB, reserved. Initial commit is 150k tokens/day, expected burst to ~1.2M/day. What RPS should we warm for?
Ben (Serving): Recommend priming for 220 rps baseline, 350 rps peak bursts for the first 6h. KV cache warmup: 12k unique prefixes.
Anya (SRE): Autoscaler tweak: current 180s cooldown causes overshoot on short bursts. Propose 90s cooldown and target 65% GPU util. Also add fallback to smaller model if error rate >2% for 2m.
Maria (Customer Success): Sales wants a 30m representative load run and a 2h soak later, plus a clip of 95th/99th latencies for the QBR.
Sam (Operations): Proposed windows: prefix warm 01:30-02:00 UTC, load 02:00-02:30 UTC, soak 04:00-06:00 UTC. Ok?
Ben (Serving): Ok. Load generator (k6): run --vus 220 --duration 30m load/zephyr.js. Payloads will sample customer prompts including long-sequence edge cases.
Anya (SRE): I'll stand up temporary dashboards and a canary route. Need the canary token. Also will monitor host-level metrics for GPU driver restarts.
Maria (Customer Success): Granting canary token to Anya now. @Sam confirm KMS alias for Zephyr keys so we have logs for compliance.
Sam (Operations): KMS alias zephyr-prod-key is attached to the pool. Opening the pool now.
deploy-bot: load-test started at 2026-03-23T02:00:12Z 1 test id: lt-5509876543-01
Ben (Serving): Initial results: 95th latency 118ms, 99th 310ms, error rate 0.8% (spike of 429s around minute 12).
Anya (SRE): I saw autoscaler scale events at minutes 12 and 14. Failure spike lines up with container pull throttling on one host; investigating IO.
Sam (Operations): Found one node with delayed GPU driver restart and high disk IO. Evacuating that node and replacing it.
Ben (Serving): After cooldown change to 90s and priming KV cache we re-ran a short probe: 95th 105ms, 99th 220ms, errors 0.2%. Stable now.
Maria (Customer Success): Great. Action items: 1) Sam to post a short incident note on the host IO root cause, 2) Anya to attach canary graphs and export 95/99 latencies, 3) Ben to upload load-run artifacts and transcripts.
Sam (Operations): Will post incident note in #postmortems with logs by EOD.
Anya (SRE): Dashboards uploaded to the Zephyr onboarding folder; shared link in DM.
Ben (Serving): Artifacts uploaded to S3: s3://redwood-ops/zephyr/lt-5509876543-01.zip
Maria (Customer Success): Please add a customer-facing note on recommended autoscale settings for ongoing headroom. Sales wants a one-line for renewal.
Sam (Operations): Recommended autoscale: target_util 65%, min_replicas 2, max_replicas 8, cooldown 90s. I'll paste into the ops doc. :white_check_mark:
Maria (Customer Success): Thanks team 1 closing sync. I'll mark the renewal tracker that performance evidence is available and the dedicated pool is green for go-live. :rocket:
